pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with smooth edge gradients and rounded vertices. Spatial area of patches decreases from the mid-neck toward the posterior flank, with higher contrast and darker pigmentation observed along the dorsal midline.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-colored pathways forming a continuous negative-space grid. Junction nodes primarily exhibit tripartite connectivity with relatively stable pixel thickness across the central flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency serrated 1D contour along the dorsal neck, representing an upright mane with uniform vertical amplitude against the out-of-focus background.
